rubric_items.reason: Uses only existing modules, symbols, the existing route and index. Follows the routes/services/repositories layering and client.ts. No new endpoint, table, migration or job.
S-1 to S-5 and their criteria all map to components: the Scheduled-after-now filter, earliest pick, None, link, Inactive doctor name, paging/search/sort regression and no medical history.
Method, path and next_appointment shape {id, starts_at, doctor_name}|null are precise. The doctor column behind doctor_name (doctor.full_name) and the id type are not stated.
Choices are cited or asked (Q-01 to Q-05). Some claims cite sections that are not in the declared inputs. The impact's question about other GET /api/patients callers is dropped.
The trade-offs cover the in-query join vs per-patient calls, widening vs a new route, null vs an omitted field, UTC vs display zone, and keeping AppointmentRepo unchanged.
Clear, consistent structure. Front matter and body agree on components, endpoints and questions.

findings.text: Claims C3, C4, C8 cite context/conventions.md, and C17, C21, C22 cite context/generated/db-schema.json. Neither file is in the design's declared inputs, so their hashes are not pinned.
findings.suggested_fix: Add context/conventions.md and context/generated/db-schema.json with their sha256 to the inputs list.

findings.text: The impact asked which other web pages call GET /api/patients (e.g. BookAppointmentPage). The design admits every caller gets the wider shape but drops that question and gives no default or regression note for other callers.

cites.quote: Besides PatientsPage, which web pages call the patient list through client.ts
the list response shape grows for every caller of `GET /api/patients`

findings.suggested_fix: Carry the impact's Q-05 forward, with its default: the field is additive and other callers get regression tests.

findings.text: S-2 is Known on the basis of a Scheduled status filter, but the design cites neither the appointment.status column nor the Scheduled status value. Its cites cover only the repo, the index and starts_at.

cites.quote: the PatientRepo query filters to status Scheduled after now

findings.suggested_fix: Add claims citing db-schema.json#column:appointment.status and data-model.md#appointments for the SCHEDULED value.

findings.text: The split's product-owner question (show, mark or hide an Inactive doctor's name) is not carried forward. The design shows the plain name without referencing that open choice.

cites.quote: should the column show the name, show it marked Inactive, or hide it?
the doctor's name is read through the appointment's `doctor_id` whether or not the doctor is Inactive

findings.suggested_fix: Reference the split's Q-04 under S-4, with its default 'Show the name'.

cites.quote: The web app talks to the API only through `web/src/api/client.ts`.
Lists answer `{ items, page, page_size, total }`, 20 per page.
Hospital time zone Asia/Kolkata, currency INR.
Medical history appears only on the patient's own page, never in lists
never request bodies, contact details or medical
Doctors and patients with appointments are made Inactive, never deleted.

questions.text: Besides PatientsPage, do any web pages (e.g. BookAppointmentPage) call GET /api/patients and need regression tests for the added next_appointment field?
